sourceFingerprintAlgorithm: sha256 over the covered paths in DECLARED ORDER; each path contributes <repo-relative path> NUL <64-hex sha256 of the file's RAW BYTES> NUL; per-file digest = script/m24/portability.ts sha256File() (node:crypto, no process spawn)
limitations: CSP is enforced by the host webview at render time; this suite proves the emitted document's policy and escaping, not browser behavior.
The future webview provider must consume buildWebviewHtml(); a provider that hand-rolls its own HTML is a governance violation (single-owner rule).
